The archive records the exact approved document, the authenticated reviewer's identity and the approval time, blocks self-approval, and enforces seven-year retention against alteration or deletion. Shipping waits until those archive controls are verified. Optional additions: none. Unmet needs: the controls are not yet verified, and no specific tool or configuration is named.
